decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit closely with the firm's dental lab materials and thermoforming know-how, so its existing knowledge base and channels make continued improvement and commercialization likely.
A PETG thermoforming blank sits very near the firm's core capabilities in custom-device materials, laboratory workflows, and precision manufacturing, which lowers the chance of withdrawal.

UV-curing lacquer is related to the firm's materials and lab-process expertise but is somewhat more peripheral than its core custom-device products, so it is keepable yet faces a moderate discontinuation risk.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build on the firm's established earmold and hearing-care competencies and specialist channels, giving it enough absorptive capacity to refine and retain the line despite some niche-market risk.
